title: Example full-text eligibility criteria
core_rule: Include a report only when every inclusion criterion is met and no exclusion criterion is triggered.
inclusion_rule: Missing information is unclear, not automatically ineligible.
exclusion_rule: Use the first clearly supported exclusion reason in the order shown.
if_uncertain: Choose Maybe and resolve the item through reviewer discussion.
guidance: Replace every example below with the protocol-approved criteria for your own review.

inclusion.name: Target population
inclusion.definition: The study includes the population defined in the review protocol.

inclusion.name: Eligible study design
inclusion.definition: The report presents an eligible primary research design.

sub_requirements.text: The report describes original data collection or analysis.
The methods and results are reported in enough detail for screening.

exclusion.name: Wrong population
exclusion.definition: The study population is entirely outside the population defined in the review protocol.

exclusion.name: Ineligible publication or design
exclusion.definition: The item is an editorial, protocol without results, commentary, or another design excluded by the protocol.

unretrieved.name: Full text not retrieved
unretrieved.definition: The full text could not be obtained after the review team's retrieval process.
